nehal-birthday.gateSubtitle: Enter the secret word to unlock your personal keepsake.
nehal-birthday.heroTagline: Another year of laughter, kindness, and unforgettable moments.
messageParagraphs: On your special day, I wanted to create something just for you — a little corner of the internet that celebrates everything that makes you Lovely.
From the way you light up every room you walk into, to the late-night conversations and inside jokes only we understand — you've made life brighter, funnier, and infinitely more meaningful.
Here's to another year of adventures, dreams coming true, and memories we'll laugh about for years. You deserve all the happiness in the world.

memories.title: The First photo
memories.caption: First time we built our bond and trust by sharing a pic with me — and trusting me, a trust that is never going to break.

memories.title: Late night talks
memories.caption: Hours that felt like minutes — sharing dreams, fears, and everything in between.

memories.title: Your birthday last year
memories.caption: The surprise, the cake fight, and you pretending to be mad while smiling the whole time.

memories.title: Every ordinary day
memories.caption: Because friendship isn't just the big moments — it's showing up, always.

nehal-birthday.wishResultText: Your wish is on its way to the stars. Happy Birthday, Nehal!
